# TrueCombat: Platinum

> TrueCombat: Platinum is a free, native 64-bit Windows rebuild of TrueCombat: Elite (TC:E), the realistic modern-combat tactical shooter originally made as a total conversion for Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory. It has a DirectX 12 renderer with an OpenGL fallback, the original maps, weapons, movement and HUD, a launcher with signed updates, official EU servers and leaderboards. It is developed by Team Terminus.

- Current version: v0.34.1 (9 Nov 2026)
- Platform: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. Price: free. Status: early access.
- Not affiliated with Team Terminator, the creators of TrueCombat: Elite. Fan project.
- The site is also available in Dutch under https://truecombat.eu/nl/.

## The game

- [Maps](https://truecombat.eu/maps.html): the six maps (Delta, Northport, Railhouse, Snow, Stadtrand, Village) with overhead layouts
- [Weapons](https://truecombat.eu/weapons.html): all 27 guns with their damage, recoil and handling values
- [Media](https://truecombat.eu/media.html): in-game screenshots from the DirectX 12 renderer
- [Competitive](https://truecombat.eu/competitive.html): match mode for clan matches: ready-up, knife round, half-time, timeouts

## Devlog

- [The road ahead, in full](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-the-road-ahead.html): The next two updates are planned, and so is the work behind them. A rebuilt movement core, a match record that powers replays and coaching, bots that have to look and listen like you do, pickup games on Discord and more. This is the long version, with how each piece works and why we are building it this way.
- [Counting readers without tracking anyone](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-reads-and-ratings.html): Every devlog post now ends with a star rating, and we can finally see which posts people read. Here is how we built that without cookies, without analytics and without storing anything that points back to you.
- [What we are working on next](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-whats-next.html): With 0.34.0 out, here is an open look at the work lined up behind it: better online play, Discord pickups, one-click joining, and a set of new features built on a shared match record. Plans, not promises.
- [Free means free: how support works](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-support.html): TrueCombat: Platinum now has a support page and a Ko-fi. Why we added it, where the money goes, and the rules we set for ourselves so that supporting never changes how the game plays.
- [What the playtests told us](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-playtest-fixes.html): Our latest community playtests turned up a clear list of problems, led by gunplay. A large batch of fixes is lined up for the next patch. Here is everything we found, the order we will fix it in, and how it fits with the rest of the work coming up.
- [The official servers now run on Linux](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-linux-servers.html): Both official servers have moved to a native Linux build of the 0.34.0 server. What that means for your matches, why we did it, and how we made sure we could undo it in seconds.
- [New light for old maps](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-ultra-visuals.html): The Ultra preset brings modern lighting, real surface materials and sun shadows to every map on DirectX 12. Here is how we built it without changing how TC:E plays.
- [Teaching bots to play like people](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-smarter-bots.html): Bots that never miss are no fun, and bots that ignore the objective are worse. This is how we test every change to Platinum's bots before it reaches a server.
- [When the test is wrong](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-recoil-check.html): Our recoil checks flagged the Desert Eagle as broken. The game was right. Here is how we found out, and why we would rather chase a false alarm than miss a real one.
- [Ten pieces of work, one update](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-one-update.html): The next update was built by ten separate efforts at the same time. How they came together into one build without stepping on each other, and what the final test gate looked like.
- [What keeps the official servers running](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-official-servers.html): Two official servers, a master list, live leaderboards and this website all run around the clock. Here is what happens behind the scenes when nobody is watching.
- [One small installer, every version](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-installer.html): Platinum used to be a zip of almost 800 MB. Now it is a 7 MB installer, a launcher that only downloads what changed, and a button that takes you back to any earlier release.
- [Every shot leaves a mark](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-every-shot.html): Bullet holes, impact sounds, the crack of a near miss and the original weapon animations. How the next update brings back the feel of a TC:E firefight.
- [Match mode, built for clan nights](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-match-mode.html): Clan matches are where TC:E lived. Platinum 0.32 brings a full match flow to every server, with a pause that freezes the whole world.
- [Back to full speed](https://truecombat.eu/devlog-full-speed.html): For months Platinum felt a step slower than the game we remember. The cause turned out to be a single scaling factor, applied in the wrong place.
